Description: Parameter Store, a tool in AWS Systems Manager, provides secure, hierarchical storage for configuration data management and secrets management. You can store data such as passwords, database strings, Amazon Machine Image \(AMI\) IDs, and license codes as parameter values. You can store values as plain text or encrypted data. You can reference Systems Manager parameters in your scripts, commands, SSM documents, and configuration and automation workflows by using the unique name that you specified when you created the parameter.

[MySQL](https://aws.amazon.com/rds/mysql/what-is-mysql/) is the world's most popular [open source](https://aws.amazon.com/products/databases/open-source-databases/) relational database and Amazon RDS makes it easier to set up, operate, and scale MySQL deployments in [the cloud](https://aws.amazon.com/what-is-cloud-computing/). With Amazon RDS, you can deploy scalable MySQL servers in minutes with cost-efficient and resizable hardware capacity.

Amazon RDS for MySQL helps to manage time-consuming database administration tasks, including backups, upgrades, software patching, performance improvements, monitoring, scaling, and replication.

Amazon RDS supports MySQL Community Edition versions 8.4 and 8.0, which means that the code, applications, and tools you already use today can be used with Amazon RDS.

AWS Management Console is a web-based interface for accessing and managing AWS cloud services and resources. The console provides a unified dashboard for monitoring, configuring, and deploying AWS infrastructure components across all available regions. Role-based access controls and multi-factor authentication ensure secure, governed access to cloud resources. The console also integrates with AWS CloudTrail to maintain a full audit trail of all management activities.

Store and protect any amount of data for a range of use cases, such as data lakes, websites, cloud-native applications, backups, archive, machine learning, and analytics.  
Amazon S3 is designed for 99.999999999% \(11 9's\) of durability, and stores data for millions of customers all around the world.

Amazon RDS for Aurora is a fully managed relational database service within AWS that combines the performance and availability of high-end commercial databases with the simplicity and cost-effectiveness of open-source engines. Aurora supports both MySQL and PostgreSQL-compatible editions, offering up to five times the throughput of standard MySQL and three times that of standard PostgreSQL. The service provides automated backups, point-in-time recovery, continuous monitoring, and multi-AZ replication to ensure high availability and durability. Aurora's distributed, fault-tolerant storage system automatically scales up to 128 TB per database instance, making it suitable for enterprise-scale workloads.

Amazon Inspector is an automated security assessment service that helps identify vulnerabilities and deviations from security best practices in AWS workloads. The service continuously scans EC2 instances, container images in Amazon ECR, and Lambda functions for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure. Findings are prioritized using a risk score that correlates vulnerability data with environmental factors, enabling efficient remediation workflows. Amazon Inspector integrates with AWS Security Hub and Amazon EventBridge to support centralized security management and automated response pipelines.

Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service \(EKS\) is a fully managed Kubernetes service that simplifies the deployment, management, and scaling of containerized applications on AWS. EKS automatically handles the availability and scalability of the Kubernetes control plane across multiple AWS availability zones, eliminating the need to install or operate a Kubernetes control plane. The service integrates natively with AWS infrastructure components such as IAM, VPC, and Elastic Load Balancing, ensuring secure and efficient cluster operations. EKS supports both EC2 and AWS Fargate as compute options, providing flexibility in workload deployment models.

Amazon ECS (Elastic Container Service) is a fully managed container orchestration service that facilitates the deployment, management, and scaling of containerized applications. It supports Docker containers and integrates natively with the AWS ecosystem, allowing networking, load balancing, and IAM role utilization. Amazon ECS offers two launch types: Fargate for serverless containers and EC2 for full server management flexibility. Its scalability and security make it suitable for various application workloads.

AWS Secrets Manager is a managed AWS service that enables secure storage, retrieval, and automatic rotation of sensitive credentials such as database passwords, API keys, and other secrets. The service integrates natively with AWS services and supports fine-grained access control via AWS IAM policies. Automatic secret rotation reduces the risk of credential exposure by eliminating the need for manual updates across dependent applications and services. Centralised secret management through this service supports compliance requirements and reduces operational overhead associated with secrets lifecycle management.

An AWS Security Group acts as a virtual firewall controlling inbound and outbound traffic for AWS resources such as EC2 instances. Rules are defined by protocol, port range, and source or destination IP ranges, enabling granular network access control. Security Groups are stateful, meaning return traffic is automatically allowed regardless of inbound rules. Multiple Security Groups can be assigned to a single resource, allowing layered and flexible security policies.

Amazon GuardDuty is a continuous threat detection service provided by AWS that monitors for malicious activity and unauthorized behavior within AWS accounts and workloads. The service analyzes data from AWS CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and DNS logs to identify potential threats such as compromised credentials, reconnaissance attacks, and data exfiltration attempts. Machine learning, anomaly detection, and integrated threat intelligence are leveraged to deliver actionable security findings. Findings are surfaced through the AWS Management Console and can be integrated with AWS Security Hub or third-party SIEM solutions for centralized security management.

AWS Backup is a fully managed cloud service that centralizes and automates data protection across AWS services and hybrid workloads. The service enables policy-based backup scheduling, retention management, and cross-region or cross-account backup replication to meet compliance and business continuity requirements. AWS Backup supports a wide range of AWS resources, including EC2, RDS, DynamoDB, EFS, and S3, providing a unified console for monitoring and auditing backup activity. Integration with AWS Organisations allows enterprise-wide backup governance and enforcement of data protection policies at scale.

Amazon Elastic File System \(EFS\) is a fully managed, scalable cloud-based NFS file storage service designed for use with AWS compute services and on-premises resources. EFS automatically scales storage capacity up or down as files are added or removed, eliminating the need for capacity provisioning. The service supports concurrent access from thousands of EC2 instances and containers, making it suitable for shared workloads such as content management, data analytics, and application hosting. EFS offers multiple storage classes, including Standard and Infrequent Access, to optimize cost based on access patterns.

AWS Certificate Manager \(ACM\) is a managed service that simplifies the provisioning, management, and deployment of SSL/TLS certificates for use with AWS services and internal connected resources. ACM handles the complexity of certificate renewal and management, eliminating manual processes and reducing the risk of certificate expiration. Certificates provisioned through ACM can be deployed directly to integrated AWS services such as Elastic Load Balancing, Amazon CloudFront, and API Gateway.
Amazon Cognito is **an identity platform for web and mobile apps**. It's a user directory, an authentication server, and an authorization service for OAuth 2.0 access tokens and AWS credentials.

AWS Fargate is a technology that you can use with Amazon ECS to run [containers](https://aws.amazon.com/containers/) without having to manage servers or clusters of Amazon EC2 instances. With AWS Fargate, you no longer have to provision, configure, or scale clusters of virtual machines to run containers. This removes the need to choose server types, decide when to scale your clusters, or optimize cluster packing.

The API gateway is an API management tool that provides a single, unified API entry point across the CCS infrastructure onto Cloud services. It also helps to provide a secure and unified entry point for external consumers, independent of the number and composition of internal microservices.

CloudWatch enables you to monitor your complete stack \(applications, infrastructure, network, and services\) and use alarms, logs, and events data to take automated actions and reduce mean time to resolution \(MTTR\).

Route 53 is a scalable and highly available Domain Name System (DNS) web service provided by AWS. It enables routing of end-user requests to internet applications by translating human-readable names into IP addresses. The service supports use cases such as DNS management, traffic routing, and health checking of resources to ensure high availability and performance. Route 53 also integrates seamlessly with other AWS services and allows routing based on latency, geolocation, or other policies.
Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud \(EC2\) is a web service that lets users create and run virtual machines, or instances, in the cloud. EC2 is a service offered by Amazon Web Services \(AWS\).

Azure API Management \(APIM\) is a fully managed Azure service that enables organisations to publish, secure, transform, and monitor APIs at scale. APIM provides a unified gateway for routing API traffic, enforcing security policies, and applying rate limiting and throttling across backend services. The service includes a developer portal for API documentation, subscription management, and self-service onboarding of API consumers. APIM supports hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, integrating with both Azure-hosted and external backend services through configurable policies and built-in analytics.

Azure Key Vault is a cloud service provided by Microsoft Azure for securely storing and managing sensitive information such as secrets, encryption keys, and certificates. The service enables centralised secret management, reducing the risk of accidental exposure by keeping credentials out of application code. Azure Key Vault integrates with other Azure services and supports hardware security modules \(HSMs\) for enhanced cryptographic key protection. Access is controlled through Azure Active Directory authentication and granular access policies, ensuring only authorised applications and users can retrieve stored assets.

Azure Cognitive Search involves organizing data in a structured way and indexing them so that they can be easily searched by users. The service provides two different indexing engines: the technology of **natural language processing** \(Natural Language Processing or NLP\) owned by Microsoft or the **analysers** of the open source libraries of **Apache Lucene**. Microsoft's search engine is built on the Elasticsearch model.

If you are indexing, for example, text documents, Azure Cognitive Search will analyze the content of each document and will create an index that associates the keywords with the documents. This index will allow Azure Cognitive Search to quickly find documents that match certain search queries.

Once the data is indexed, users will be able to search using specific keywords or phrases. When a user enters a search query, Azure Cognitive Search will review the data index to find matches between the keywords and the previously indexed data.

The results will be ranked by Cognitive Search based on their relevance. There are several factors to determine the relevance of a result, such as the frequency of keywords in the document or their position in it.

What sets Azure Cognitive Search apart is the incorporation of Artificial Intelligence capabilities in order to vastly improve search functionality.

Azure Redis Cache is **a fully managed, in-memory caching service from Microsoft that uses the open-source Redis engine to provide high-performance and low-latency data access for applications**{color:rgb(10, 10, 10)/}. It is used to improve application performance by storing frequently accessed data in memory, reducing the load on backend databases. The service can be used as a standalone cache, a distributed cache, a session store, or a message broker.{color}

Azure Storage Blob is a Microsoft Azure cloud service designed for storing large amounts of unstructured data, such as text, binary data, images, and documents. The service supports three types of blobs: block blobs for streaming and storing cloud objects, append blobs optimized for append operations, and page blobs for random read/write operations. Azure Storage Blob provides tiered storage options \(Hot, Cool, and Archive\) to optimize costs based on data access frequency. Integration with Azure Active Directory, shared access signatures, and encryption at rest ensures enterprise-grade security and compliance.

Azure Managed Relational Database is a fully managed cloud database service hosted on Microsoft Azure, providing enterprise-grade relational database capabilities without the overhead of infrastructure management. The service supports multiple database engines and ensures high availability, automated backups, and built-in disaster recovery. Microsoft Entra Domain Services provides managed domain services such as domain join, group policy, LDAP, and Kerberos/NTLM authentication without the need to deploy or manage domain controllers. Microsoft Entra Domain Services synchronises identity information from the parent Microsoft Entra tenant, supporting hybrid identity scenarios and legacy application modernisation. This managed service eliminates the operational overhead of patching, monitoring, and maintaining domain controller infrastructure.

Azure Network Security Groups \(NSG\) are a core Azure networking component used to filter inbound and outbound network traffic to and from Azure resources within a virtual network. NSGs contain security rules that allow or deny traffic based on source/destination IP addresses, ports, and protocols. Each rule is assigned a priority, and rules are evaluated in priority order until a match is found. NSGs can be associated with subnets or individual network interfaces to enforce granular access control across the Azure infrastructure.

Azure Sentinel is a cloud-native Security Information and Event Management \(SIEM\) and Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response \(SOAR\) solution hosted on Microsoft Azure. The service collects security data at scale across the enterprise, including users, devices, applications, and infrastructure, both on-premises and across multiple clouds. Built-in AI and machine learning capabilities enable rapid threat detection, investigation, and response, reducing alert fatigue and improving security operations efficiency. Azure Sentinel integrates natively with existing Azure services and supports a broad range of third-party connectors for comprehensive security coverage.

Azure Monitor is a comprehensive cloud monitoring service that collects, analyses, and acts on telemetry data from Azure and on-premises environments. The service provides full-stack observability by aggregating metrics, logs, and traces across applications, infrastructure, and network layers. Built-in analytics, dashboards, and alerting capabilities enable rapid detection and diagnosis of performance issues and operational anomalies. Integration with tools such as Log Analytics, Application Insights, and Azure Alerts enables automated responses and streamlined incident management.

Azure VNet \(Virtual Network\) is a fundamental networking infrastructure component within Microsoft Azure that enables the creation of isolated, logically segmented network environments in the cloud. Azure VNET allows secure communication between Azure resources, on-premises networks, and the internet through configurable address spaces, subnets, and routing tables. Network security groups \(NSGs\) and service endpoints provide granular traffic control and enhanced security boundaries. Azure VNET supports hybrid connectivity scenarios via VPN Gateway or ExpressRoute, facilitating seamless integration with enterprise on-premises infrastructure.

Azure Portal is a web-based, unified management console hosted at portal.azure.com that provides a graphical interface for managing Azure cloud resources and services. The portal enables resource provisioning, monitoring, and configuration across all Azure subscriptions and services within the organization. Role-based access control \(RBAC\) integration ensures that resource access and management capabilities align with organizational security policies. The portal also supports the creation of custom dashboards for real-time visibility into resource health, costs, and performance metrics.

Data Warehouse is a Cloud based data storage platform  
Data Warehouse is a system used for reporting and data analysis and is considered a core component of business intelligence. A data warehouse is a system that pulls together data from many different sources within an organization for reporting and analysis

Azure Backup is a cloud-based data protection service provided by Microsoft Azure that enables secure, scalable backup of on-premises and cloud workloads. The service supports a wide range of backup targets, including virtual machines, SQL databases, SAP HANA, Azure file shares, and on-premises servers. Azure Backup stores data in Recovery Services vaults, providing geo-redundant storage options to ensure data durability and availability. Built-in security features include encryption at rest and in transit, role-based access control, and soft-delete to protect against accidental or malicious data deletion.
